derivation:
by
  rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂]; congr 1
  exact Polynomial.ringHom_ext' (RingHom.ext_int _ _) (by simp)
explanation: Specialize hom_eval₂ to the coefficient map (aeval a).toRingHom. Routine extensionality identifies its composition with g as (aeval (g a)).toRingHom, since ring homomorphisms agree on integers.
